canonical_statement: Emotional states function as active transmissions that broadcast information to the universe.

attributions.surface_quote: Your feelings are not reactions. They are transmissions.

canonical_statement: Individual vision serves as an instructional directive for the manifestation of universal events.

attributions.surface_quote: Your vision... is your instruction set to the universe.

canonical_statement: The process of learning is fundamentally an act of remembering pre-existing knowledge.

attributions.surface_quote: Not knowledge. Not belief. But remembrance.
